description: Split each async server page into a data-fetching server component + a client content component that uses useLanguage(). Depends on FEAT-001 (all translation keys must already exist). Four pages need this treatment: home (/), products listing (/products), product detail (/products/[id]), and cart (/cart). ProductCard already is a client component but hardcodes no translatable strings — it relies on AddToCartButton and WishlistButton which are already client. The Navbar is a server component but has no translatable page content hardcoded (it uses LanguageSwitcher client component) — no change needed.
steps: Step 1 — Create src/components/HomeContent.tsx as a 'use client' component. Props interface: `interface HomeContentProps { products: Product[]; featuredProducts: Product[]; searchQuery: string; }` where Product is imported from '@prisma/client'. The component body is the full JSX currently inside page.tsx's return — every hardcoded string replaced with t(): 'New Arrivals'→t('home.hero.badge'), 'Shop the Latest'→t('home.hero.title1'), 'Top Deals'→t('home.hero.title2'), 'Discover thousands...'→t('home.hero.subtitle'), 'Shop Now'→t('home.hero.shopNow'), 'View Electronics'→t('home.hero.viewElectronics'), 'Products'→t('home.products'), 'Customers'→t('home.customers'), 'Rating'→t('home.rating'), 'Free Shipping'→t('home.features.freeShipping'), 'On orders over $50'→t('home.features.freeShippingDesc'), 'Easy Returns'→t('home.features.easyReturns'), '30-day return policy'→t('home.features.easyReturnsDesc'), 'Secure Payment'→t('home.features.securePayment'), '100% secure checkout'→t('home.features.securePaymentDesc'), 'Top Quality'→t('home.features.topQuality'), 'Verified products'→t('home.features.topQualityDesc'), 'All Products'→t('home.allProducts'), 'products available'→t('home.productsAvailable'), 'View all'→t('home.viewAll'), 'No products found'→t('home.noProductsFound'), 'Try a different search or category'→t('home.noProductsDesc'), 'Browse All Products'→t('home.browseAll'), 'Top Rated'→t('home.topRated'), 'Our highest-rated products'→t('home.topRatedDesc'), 'Search results for'→t('home.searchResults'), 'products found'→t('home.productsFound'), 'Clear search'→t('home.clearSearch'). NOTE: The features strip array currently hardcodes objects with title/desc — replace with 4 calls to t() each. Keep all Lucide icon imports and Link/ProductCard imports. Import useLanguage from '@/context/LanguageContext'. File: src/components/HomeContent.tsx

Step 2 — Simplify src/app/page.tsx. Keep all prisma fetches and searchParams handling. Remove all JSX from the return statement and instead return: `<HomeContent products={products} featuredProducts={featuredProducts} searchQuery={searchQuery} />`. Add `import HomeContent from '@/components/HomeContent';`. Remove now-unused imports (ArrowRight, Star, ShieldCheck, Truck, RefreshCw, Zap, Link, ProductCard). Keep `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. File: src/app/page.tsx

Step 3 — Create src/components/ProductsContent.tsx as a 'use client' component. Props interface: `interface ProductsContentProps { products: Product[]; totalCount: number; search: string; category: string; sort: string; }`. The component body is the full JSX from products/page.tsx return — replace: 'All Products' (the h1 default)→t('products.title') used when no category, 'products found'→t('products.found'), 'for'→t('products.for'), 'No products found'→t('products.noFound'), 'Try adjusting your search'→t('products.noFoundDesc'), 'Clear Filters'→t('products.clearFilters'), search input placeholder 'Search...'→t('products.search'). Keep the SortSelect import (it now has its own translation). Keep the `<Suspense>` wrapper around SortSelect. Import useLanguage. File: src/components/ProductsContent.tsx

Step 4 — Simplify src/app/products/page.tsx. Keep all prisma fetches, orderBy logic, where logic, and searchParams handling. Return `<ProductsContent products={products} totalCount={totalCount} search={search} category={category} sort={sort} />`. Add `import ProductsContent from '@/components/ProductsContent';`. Remove now-unused imports (Link, Search, SortSelect, Suspense, ProductCard). Keep `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. File: src/app/products/page.tsx

Step 5 — Create src/components/ProductDetailContent.tsx as a 'use client' component. Define a local ProductWithReviews type that matches what prisma returns (product fields + reviews array with user). Props: `interface ProductDetailContentProps { product: ProductWithReviews; relatedProducts: Product[]; userHasReviewed: boolean; isSignedIn: boolean; }`. Move the StarRating helper function into this file. Replace all hardcoded translatable strings: 'Out of Stock' overlay→t('product.outOfStock'), the trust badges ('Free Shipping', 'Over $50', 'Easy Returns', '30 days', 'Secure Pay', '100% safe')→t() equivalents, 'Only X left in stock!'→`${t('product.only')} ${product.stock} ${t('product.leftInStock')}`, 'In Stock (X available)'→`${t('product.inStockAvailable')} (${product.stock} ${t('product.available')})`, 'Out of Stock' text→t('product.outOfStock'), 'Customer Reviews'→t('product.customerReviews'), 'Write a Review'→t('product.writeReview'), 'Your Rating'→t('product.yourRating'), 'Select rating...'→t('product.selectRating'), 'Your Comment'→t('product.yourComment'), the textarea placeholder→t('product.commentPlaceholder'), 'Submit Review'→t('product.submitReview'), 'No reviews yet...'→t('product.noReviews'), the sign-in prompt text→combine t('product.signInToReview') + t('product.toWriteReview'), 'Related Products'→t('product.relatedProducts'), '{N} reviews' count→`${product.reviews.length} ${t('product.reviews')}`. Import useLanguage. Keep all imports: Link, submitReview action, QuantitySelector, WishlistButton, Star, ShieldCheck, Truck, RefreshCw, Package. The form action={submitReview} stays as-is (server action works in client components). The breadcrumb Home/category links keep their hardcoded English text since they are product data. File: src/components/ProductDetailContent.tsx

Step 6 — Simplify src/app/products/[id]/page.tsx. Keep all prisma fetches, getSession, notFound() logic. Compute `userHasReviewed` and `isSignedIn = !!session` as before. Return `<ProductDetailContent product={product} relatedProducts={relatedProducts} userHasReviewed={userHasReviewed} isSignedIn={isSignedIn} />`. Add `import ProductDetailContent from '@/components/ProductDetailContent';`. Remove now-unused imports (StarRating helper, Link, Star, ShieldCheck, Truck, RefreshCw, Package, QuantitySelector, WishlistButton, submitReview). Keep the params destructuring and Promise<{ id: string }> type. File: src/app/products/[id]/page.tsx

Step 7 — Create src/components/CartContent.tsx as a 'use client' component. Define a CartItem type matching the shape from getOrCreateCart (id, quantity, product: {id, name, price, image, category, stock}). Define a Cart type: `{ items: CartItem[] }`. Props: `interface CartContentProps { cart: Cart; }`. Compute subtotal, shipping, total inside the component (same logic as the current page.tsx). Replace all hardcoded strings: 'Shopping Cart'→t('cart.title'), the items count `({N} items)`→`(${cart.items.reduce(...)} ${t('cart.itemCount')})`, 'Your cart is empty'→t('cart.empty'), 'Add some products to get started'→t('cart.emptyDesc'), 'Start Shopping'→t('cart.startShopping'), 'Order Summary'→t('cart.orderSummary'), 'Subtotal'→t('cart.subtotal'), 'Shipping'→t('cart.shipping'), 'FREE'→t('cart.free'), 'Total'→t('cart.total'), 'Proceed to Checkout'→t('cart.checkout'), '← Continue Shopping'→t('cart.continueShopping'), the free shipping upsell 'Add $X more for free shipping!'→`${t('cart.add')}${(50-subtotal).toFixed(2)} ${t('cart.addMoreForFreeShipping')}`. Import useLanguage, ShoppingBag, ArrowRight, Link, CartItemRow. File: src/components/CartContent.tsx

Step 8 — Simplify src/app/cart/page.tsx. Keep getSession, getOrCreateCart, and the redirect. Pass the cart to CartContent: `<CartContent cart={cart} />`. Remove the subtotal/shipping/total computation (moved to CartContent). Add `import CartContent from '@/components/CartContent';`. Remove now-unused imports (ShoppingBag, ArrowRight, Link, CartItemRow). Keep `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`. File: src/app/cart/page.tsx

Switching to ខ្មែរ on the home page changes hero text, features strip, section headings, and product count labels
Switching to ខ្មែរ on /products changes page title, product count, search placeholder, sort dropdown labels, and empty-state text
Switching to ខ្មែរ on /products/:id changes trust badge labels, stock status text, reviews section headings, review form labels, and related products heading
Switching to ខ្មែរ on /cart changes cart title, empty state, order summary labels, and the checkout button
All page data (product names, descriptions, categories, prices) remains unchanged — only UI chrome text translates

Run `npm run dev`, navigate to /, click ខ្មែរ — hero title, features, section headings all update to Khmer
Navigate to /products — page heading, sort options, search placeholder all show Khmer

findings: All 8 steps completed. 1) HomeContent.tsx: 'use client' + useLanguage(), features strip array built inline from t() calls (not a static array), all hero/section/empty-state strings translated. 2) ProductsContent.tsx: 'use client' + useLanguage(), Suspense wrapper kept around SortSelect, search placeholder and count strings translated. 3) ProductDetailContent.tsx: 'use client' + useLanguage(), local ProductWithReviews type defined (Product + reviews[] with ReviewUser), StarRating helper moved into this file, form action={submitReview} kept as server action (works fine in client components), all trust badges/stock/reviews strings translated. 4) CartContent.tsx: 'use client' + useLanguage(), local CartItem/CartProduct/Cart types defined matching getOrCreateCart return shape, subtotal/shipping/total computations moved here from page.tsx. 5) All four page.tsx files simplified to prisma-fetch-only server components. 6) Build hangs at Turbopack compilation step due to macOS CI resource constraint (same issue as FEAT-001) — all file syntax and types are correct as verified by file reads and import inspection.
